title: Emotionally
subtitle: 在心理上；從心理狀態而言
description: 在心理上；從心理狀態而言

words.meaning: 在心理上；從心理狀態而言
words.note: 當 emotionally 涉及一個人的心理狀態、心理健康或長期內在影響時，psychologically 可以作近義改寫。不過 psychologically 範圍較廣，也可包括思考、認知與其他心理歷程，因此並非所有 emotionally 都能直接替換。
words.example: The experience affected her psychologically for months.
words.exampleZh: 這次經歷在心理上影響了她好幾個月。

exercises.original: The accident affected him emotionally for months, leaving him anxious and unable to relax.
exercises.zh: 這宗意外在心理上影響了他好幾個月，令他焦慮而且無法放鬆。
exercises.upgrade: psychologically · 在心理上；從心理狀態而言

options.explanation: physically = 在身體上。題目後面是 anxious and unable to relax，重點是心理影響。
psychologically = 在心理上。長期焦慮與無法放鬆都是明確心理狀態線索。
socially = 在社交上。句子沒有談人際關係或社交功能。
dramatically = 戲劇性地／大幅度地。只表示程度或方式，不表示心理層面。
personally = 就個人而言／親自。不能精準表達心理影響。
sentimentally = 感傷地／多愁善感地。意思較窄，通常帶懷舊或感情色彩。

exercises.original: Children can be emotionally harmed by repeated humiliation even when there is no physical injury.
exercises.zh: 即使沒有身體傷害，兒童也可能因反覆受辱而受到心理傷害。
exercises.upgrade: psychologically · 在心理上；從心理狀態而言

options.explanation: socially only = 只在社交上。受辱可能影響社交，但句子說的是 harm 本身的心理層面。
physically = 身體上。原句明確說 no physical injury。
personally = 個人地／親自。不是心理傷害術語。
sensitively = 敏感／體貼地。不能修飾 harmed 表示心理層面。
psychologically = 心理上。humiliation + no physical injury 明確對比心理與身體傷害。
passionately = 熱情地。完全不合。

exercises.original: She felt emotionally prepared for the interview after practising how to handle difficult questions.
exercises.zh: 練習如何處理困難問題後，她在心理上已準備好面試。
exercises.upgrade: psychologically · 在心理上；從心理狀態而言

options.explanation: psychologically = 心理上。prepared for difficult questions 是心理準備與壓力應對。
physically = 身體上。題目沒有體能準備。
socially = 社交上。不是社交身份。
sentimentally = 感傷地。無關。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。不能表示準備的層面。
sensitively = 敏感／體貼地。語法與意思都不合。

words.meaning: 就感受而言；從感情方面來說
words.note: 當 emotionally 用來對比不同層面，例如 physically / financially / emotionally，而句子希望清楚說明『就感受而言』，可用 in terms of feelings。這是直接、易懂的解釋性改寫。
words.example: In terms of feelings, she was relieved rather than angry.
words.exampleZh: 就感受而言，她其實是鬆一口氣，而不是生氣。

exercises.original: Emotionally, he was more relieved than disappointed when the project ended.
exercises.zh: 就感受而言，項目結束時他更多是鬆一口氣，而不是失望。
exercises.upgrade: in terms of feelings · 就感受而言；從感情方面來說

options.explanation: physically = 身體上。relieved/disappointed 都是感受，不是身體狀態。
socially = 社交上。不是人際關係。
mentally only = 心智／認知上。範圍較廣，不能精準對應 relieved versus disappointed。
in terms of feelings = 就感受而言。後面的 relieved / disappointed 正好直接界定 feelings。
financially = 財務上。無關。
dramatically = 戲劇性地／大幅度地。不是層面分類。

exercises.original: Emotionally, the move was difficult even though it was the right decision financially.
exercises.zh: 就感受而言，搬遷很困難，雖然從財務角度看這是正確決定。
exercises.upgrade: in terms of feelings · 就感受而言；從感情方面來說

options.explanation: personally only = 對個人而言。太廣，不能明確和 financially 對比。
socially = 社交上。沒有社交線索。
in terms of feelings = 就感受而言。和 financially 形成清楚的層面對比。
physically = 身體上。無關。
professionally = 職業上。無關。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。不是比較層面。

exercises.original: Emotionally, she wanted to stay, although logically she knew leaving was sensible.
exercises.zh: 從感受方面來說，她想留下；但理性上她知道離開才合理。
exercises.upgrade: in terms of feelings · 就感受而言；從感情方面來說

options.explanation: logically = 邏輯上。後半句才是 logically，和前半感受相反。
physically = 身體上。無關。
socially = 社交上。無關。
personally = 個人而言。不能清楚對比 feelings 與 logic。
sensitively = 敏感／體貼地。不是層面副詞。
in terms of feelings = 就感受而言。和 logically 的對比非常明確。

words.meaning: 在情感層面上；在感情上
words.note: 當 emotionally 描述人與人、作品與觀眾之間的情感連結、理解或影響時，可用 on an emotional level。它特別自然於 connect / relate / affect / understand 等動詞。
words.example: The story connected with audiences on an emotional level.
words.exampleZh: 這個故事在情感層面上和觀眾產生共鳴。

exercises.original: The two friends connected emotionally even though their backgrounds were very different.
exercises.zh: 兩位朋友雖然背景不同，卻在情感層面上很有連結。
exercises.upgrade: on an emotional level · 在情感層面上；在感情上

options.explanation: socially only = 只在社交上。朋友當然有社交關係，但 connected emotionally 指的是感情連結。
professionally = 專業上。無關。
intellectually = 思想／智識上。可有 intellectual connection，但不是原句。
physically = 身體上。意思完全不同。
on an emotional level = 在情感層面上。connected 是最典型搭配之一。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。不是連結層面。

exercises.original: The novel affected me emotionally long after I finished reading it.
exercises.zh: 讀完小說很久之後，它仍在情感層面上影響着我。
exercises.upgrade: on an emotional level · 在情感層面上；在感情上

options.explanation: with feeling = 帶感情地。通常修飾說話、朗讀、演奏的方式，不是 affected 的受影響層面。
on an emotional level = 在情感層面上。affected me + long after reading 是自然情感影響。
physically = 身體上。沒有身體影響線索。
socially = 社交上。無關。
technically = 技術上。無關。
sentimentally only = 感傷／懷舊地。範圍太窄。

exercises.original: They understood each other emotionally even when they disagreed about the facts.
exercises.zh: 即使對事實有分歧，他們仍在情感層面上理解彼此。
exercises.upgrade: on an emotional level · 在情感層面上；在感情上

options.explanation: on an emotional level = 在情感層面上。與 disagreed about the facts 形成感情理解 versus 事實判斷的清楚對比。
factually = 就事實而言。恰好是他們有分歧的部分。
physically = 身體上。無關。
professionally = 專業上。無關。
financially = 財務上。無關。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。不是理解層面。

words.note: 當 emotionally 用來評估一個決定、經歷或情況，意思是『如果從感情角度來看』，可用 from an emotional perspective。它較正式，適合比較 emotional / practical / financial perspectives。
words.example: From an emotional perspective, leaving the house was very difficult.
words.exampleZh: 從情感角度來看，離開那間屋非常困難。

exercises.original: Emotionally, selling the family home was far harder than the financial decision itself.
exercises.zh: 從情感角度來看，出售家庭住宅遠比財務決定本身困難。
exercises.upgrade: from an emotional perspective · 從情感角度來看

options.explanation: financially = 財務上。句子明確把 emotional difficulty 和 financial decision 對比。
socially = 社交上。無關。
from an emotional perspective = 從情感角度。是對整個賣屋決定作角度評估。
physically = 身體上。無關。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。不是觀點角度。
technically = 技術上。無關。

exercises.original: Emotionally, returning to the town was more complicated than she had expected.
exercises.zh: 從情感角度來看，重返這個小鎮比她預期更複雜。
exercises.upgrade: from an emotional perspective · 從情感角度來看

options.explanation: in public = 在公開場合。無關。
technically = 技術上。無關。
financially = 財務上。沒有金錢線索。
physically = 身體上。不是身體難度。
professionally = 職業上。無關。
from an emotional perspective = 從情感角度。returning to a meaningful place + complicated feelings 很自然。

exercises.original: Emotionally, the apology mattered more to him than the money he received.
exercises.zh: 從情感角度來看，道歉對他比收到的金錢更重要。
exercises.upgrade: from an emotional perspective · 從情感角度來看

options.explanation: financially = 財務上。後面的 money 才代表財務價值。
personally only = 就個人而言。太廣，不能清楚指出 feelings。
socially = 社交上。無關。
from an emotional perspective = 從情感角度。apology versus money 是情感價值與財務價值的直接對比。
physically = 身體上。無關。
legally = 法律上。無關。

words.meaning: 從情感層面來說；以情感角度而言
words.note: in emotional terms 適合把整段經歷、時期或事件概括成情感上的狀態，例如 difficult / exhausting / rewarding。它較書面，也常和 practical / financial terms 對比。
words.example: In emotional terms, the year was exhausting.
words.exampleZh: 從情感層面來說，那一年令人筋疲力盡。

exercises.original: Emotionally, the year was exhausting even though her career was going well.
exercises.zh: 從情感層面來說，那一年令人筋疲力盡，雖然她的事業發展不錯。
exercises.upgrade: in emotional terms · 從情感層面來說；以情感角度而言

options.explanation: professionally = 職業上。後半句 career was going well 已是職業層面。
in emotional terms = 從情感層面來說。exhausting 對比 career success，清楚表情感總結。
financially = 財務上。無關。
physically only = 只在身體上。exhausting 此處是情感消耗。
socially = 社交上。無關。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。不是分類角度。

exercises.original: Emotionally, the reunion was rewarding but also surprisingly difficult.
exercises.zh: 從情感層面來說，重聚很有意義，但也出乎意料地困難。
exercises.upgrade: in emotional terms · 從情感層面來說；以情感角度而言

options.explanation: in emotional terms = 從情感層面來說。rewarding + difficult 都是在總結重聚的情緒感受。
financially = 財務上。無關。
technically = 技術上。無關。
physically = 身體上。不是題意。
socially only = 只在社交上。reunion 有社交面，但句子強調內在感受。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。無關。

exercises.original: Emotionally, caring for a sick parent can be extremely demanding.
exercises.zh: 從情感層面來說，照顧患病父母可以非常吃力。
exercises.upgrade: in emotional terms · 從情感層面來說；以情感角度而言

options.explanation: physically only = 只在身體上。照顧可有體力負擔，但原句指定 emotional。
financially = 財務上。不是這一句的焦點。
socially = 社交上。無關。
professionally = 職業上。無關。
in emotional terms = 從情感層面來說。caring for a sick parent + demanding 是自然的情感負荷總結。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。無關。

words.meaning: 帶着感情地；情緒激動地
words.note: 當 emotionally 修飾說話、回憶、感謝或表達，意思是『帶着明顯情緒』，可用 with emotion。這是 manner（方式）用法，不是『在情感層面』。
words.example: She spoke with emotion about the people who had helped her.
words.exampleZh: 她帶着感情談起曾經幫助她的人。

exercises.original: She spoke emotionally about her late grandfather and had to pause several times.
exercises.zh: 她帶着感情談起已故祖父，期間幾次要停下來。
exercises.upgrade: with emotion · 帶着感情地；情緒激動地

options.explanation: dramatically only = 戲劇性地。可能暗示誇張表演，原句沒有。
sentimentally = 感傷／多愁善感地。可接近，但範圍較窄且帶特定情緒色彩。
technically = 技術上。無關。
psychologically = 心理上。不能修飾 spoke 表達方式。
socially = 社交上。無關。
with emotion = 帶着感情地。late grandfather + had to pause 是明顯情緒流露。

exercises.original: He thanked the medical team emotionally, his voice shaking as he spoke.
exercises.zh: 他帶着感情感謝醫療團隊，說話時聲音顫抖。
exercises.upgrade: with emotion · 帶着感情地；情緒激動地

options.explanation: passionately = 熱情地／強烈地。可有情緒，但 thanking with a shaking voice 更直接是 with emotion。
sensitively = 體貼／敏感地。不是說話者情緒流露。
with emotion = 帶着感情。voice shaking 是決定性線索。
psychologically = 心理上。不能表方式。
personally = 親自／個人而言。無關。
socially = 社交上。無關。

exercises.original: The survivor spoke emotionally about the moment the rescue team arrived.
exercises.zh: 生還者帶着強烈感情談到救援隊抵達的一刻。
exercises.upgrade: with emotion · 帶着感情地；情緒激動地

options.explanation: physically = 身體上。無關。
technically = 技術上。無關。
financially = 財務上。無關。
with emotion = 帶着感情地。survivor + rescue moment 是自然強烈情緒語境。
professionally = 專業上。不是表達方式。
socially = 社交上。無關。

words.meaning: 富有感情地；有感情地表現
words.note: 當 emotionally 描述朗讀、歌唱、演奏、表演或說台詞時，可用 with feeling。它強調表達有感情、有感染力，而不一定表示本人真的情緒激動。
words.example: She read the poem slowly and with feeling.
words.exampleZh: 她慢慢而富有感情地朗讀詩歌。

exercises.original: He read the poem emotionally, giving special weight to the final lines.
exercises.zh: 他富有感情地朗讀詩歌，特別強調最後幾行。
exercises.upgrade: with feeling · 富有感情地；有感情地表現

options.explanation: with feeling = 富有感情地。poem reading + special weight to final lines 是典型表演語境。
dramatically only = 戲劇化地。可有表演效果，但不等於有感情。
sentimentally = 感傷地。情緒類型太窄。
technically = 技術上。只重技巧，不能表感情。
psychologically = 心理上。無法修飾朗讀方式。
socially = 社交上。無關。

exercises.original: The singer performed the final verse emotionally rather than simply singing the notes correctly.
exercises.zh: 歌手富有感情地唱出最後一節，而不只是把音唱準。
exercises.upgrade: with feeling · 富有感情地；有感情地表現

options.explanation: psychologically = 心理上。不是演唱方式。
technically = 技術上。後半句正是 contrasted with simply singing notes correctly。
passionately only = 熱情地。可能過強且偏 enthusiasm。
sentimentally = 感傷地。未必是悲傷或懷舊情緒。
with feeling = 富有感情地。和 purely technical singing 形成自然對比。
personally = 個人地／親自。無關。

exercises.original: The actor delivered the final line emotionally, making the audience feel the character's grief.
exercises.zh: 演員富有感情地說出最後一句，令觀眾感受到角色的悲傷。
exercises.upgrade: with feeling · 富有感情地；有感情地表現

options.explanation: physically = 身體上。無關。
with feeling = 富有感情地。actor + delivered line + audience felt grief 是典型表演用法。
socially = 社交上。無關。
technically = 技術上。不能完整表達情感感染力。
financially = 財務上。無關。
professionally = 專業地。專業不等於有感情。

words.meaning: 在情感／情緒反應方面（心理學術語）
words.note: affectively 是心理學、教育研究和認知科學中的較專門用語，指情緒、感受或 affect 層面的反應。它不是一般日常英語的首選，但在技術語境可精準替代某些 emotionally。
words.example: Participants responded affectively to the images before evaluating them consciously.
words.exampleZh: 參與者先在情感層面對圖片作出反應，之後才有意識地評估。

exercises.original: In the study, participants responded emotionally to the images before giving a conscious verbal judgement.
exercises.zh: 研究中，參與者先在情感反應層面回應圖片，之後才作出有意識的口頭判斷。
exercises.upgrade: affectively · 在情感／情緒反應方面（心理學術語）

options.explanation: socially = 社交上。研究沒有談社交互動。
physically = 身體上。不是身體反射。
financially = 財務上。無關。
affectively = 在情感反應方面。study + emotional response before conscious judgement 是典型心理學用語。
dramatically = 戲劇性地。不是研究分類。
personally = 個人而言。太一般。

exercises.original: The researchers measured how children reacted emotionally to positive and negative facial expressions.
exercises.zh: 研究人員量度兒童在情感反應上如何回應正面和負面面部表情。
exercises.upgrade: affectively · 在情感／情緒反應方面（心理學術語）

options.explanation: cognitively only = 只在認知上。題目明確是 emotional reaction，而非只測思考。
socially = 社交上。面部表情是社交刺激，但測的是情感反應。
physically = 身體上。不是單純生理反應。
financially = 財務上。無關。
professionally = 專業上。無關。
affectively = 在情感反應層面。positive/negative facial expressions + researchers measured 是典型技術語境。

exercises.original: The experiment asked whether music influenced people emotionally before it influenced their conscious ratings.
exercises.zh: 實驗探討音樂是否先影響人的情感反應，再影響有意識評分。
exercises.upgrade: affectively · 在情感／情緒反應方面（心理學術語）

options.explanation: socially = 社交上。無關。
personally = 個人而言。太模糊。
affectively = 在情感反應層面。和 conscious ratings 的對比正是技術上 affect versus cognition。
physically = 身體上。不是題目測量層面。
cognitively = 認知上。後半 conscious ratings 才較接近認知判斷。
psychologically broadly = 廣義心理上。可能涵蓋情感與認知，無法和 conscious ratings 精準區分。

falseSynonyms.zh: 在心智上；精神上不等於一般的 emotionally mentally 範圍較廣，可指思考、記憶、注意力、心智狀態等；emotionally 專指感受與情緒。兩者有時重疊，但不能一般互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Mental functioning includes cognition as well as emotion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 就個人而言；親自不等於一般的 emotionally personally 可表示『我個人認為』或『親自』，不等於在情感層面。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Personally gives an individual viewpoint; emotionally refers to feelings.

falseSynonyms.zh: 敏感地；體貼地不等於一般的 emotionally sensitively 通常指以體貼、敏銳或不冒犯人的方式行事；不是『在情感上』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can respond sensitively without being emotionally affected.

falseSynonyms.zh: 感傷地；多愁善感地不等於一般的 emotionally sentimentally 是 emotionally 的一個較窄情緒方式，常帶懷舊、柔情或過度感傷；不能涵蓋所有 emotion。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sentimentality is one kind of emotional expression.

falseSynonyms.zh: 熱情地；強烈地不等於一般的 emotionally passionately 表示強烈熱情、信念或激情；情緒可以是悲傷、恐懼、平靜等，不一定 passionate。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Passion is only one type of strong emotion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 戲劇性地；大幅度地不等於一般的 emotionally dramatically 可指表現誇張或變化巨大，並不等於感情上受到影響。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Dramatic change is about scale or theatrical effect, not necessarily emotion.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不理性地不等於一般的 emotionally 情緒化不等於不理性；一個人可以有強烈感受，同時仍然作出理性判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Emotion and irrationality are not the same thing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 在身體上不等於一般的 emotionally physically 指身體或物理層面，常和 emotionally 形成對比，因此不是同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Physically concerns the body; emotionally concerns feelings.
